data.body: Dispatched separate B2 implementation worker at standard/mid tier (gpt-5.6-terra, high reasoning) because this is a multi-file init/CLI/library change. Worker sees only tests/unit/test_init_attach_predicate.py (2 RED happy-path nodes); tests/integration/test_init_fail_closed.py with 10 edge/E2E nodes is physically held at /tmp/rebar-b2-heldout-test_init_fail_closed.py and declared off-limits. Worker brief includes the 800 LOC hard cap, Ruff/type constraints, named 10s probe bound, and requires attempt count.
